title: Heterogeneous region-aware fallback orchestrator for mixed-variant canaries
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an orchestrator that computes and executes heterogeneous fallback plans during canary and A/B rollouts. The orchestrator must consider model-variant compatibility, multi-region capacity tiers, and customer-specific routing policies to preserve latency and error SLOs while minimizing cost and avoiding noisy rollbacks.
background: Current rollout tooling handles simple failover (primary -> secondary) but lacks awareness of: (1) variant compatibility (e.g., quantized vs fp16), (2) per-region capacity tiers (dedicated vs shared), and (3) mixed canaries where multiple variants are active concurrently. Past incidents showed a naive failover either routed traffic to overloaded regions or to incompatible variants causing silent quality regressions.
design_decisions: Represent fallback topology as an ordered lattice of fallback targets scored by compatibility, capacity headroom, and cost.
Compute live compatibility score per request-class using runtime semantic hints (input length, tokens-per-response distribution) and model metadata (max sequence, supported ops).
Prefer intra-region fallbacks first when capacity headroom >= 20% to reduce cross-region latency unless regional SLOs are breached.
Allow policy overrides: enterprise customers can opt out of cross-region fallback or enforce region-only routing.
Use staged weight rebalancing with ramp windows and circuit breakers rather than instant cutover to prevent cascading overloads.
progress_updates: 2025-11-20: Initial RFC drafted (link in 'links'). Core concepts: compatibility scoring, fallback lattice, staged rebalancing.
2025-12-05: Spike implemented that computes compatibility score from model metadata + probe results; validated on small synthetic workload in staging (p50 latency preserved).
2026-01-09: Developed capacity tier model: dedicated, reserved-burst, shared. Integrated with monitoring to surface headroom per zone.
2026-01-28: Implemented staged rebalancer prototype: supports weight ramps with safety windows and rollback triggers based on p99/err_rate/semantic-regression metric.
2026-02-15: Integrated shadowing hook for quality checks: duplicate canary traffic to candidate fallback variant and compute nlg-based similarity scores without affecting user path.

2026-03-02: End-to-end integration tests added; simulated cross-region outage and verified orchestrator prioritized intra-region degraded variants, then cross-region only when intra-region headroom < threshold.
2026-03-10: Added enterprise routing policy override and persisted policy as part of deployment manifest (PR opened).
Notes: still need to tune rollback thresholds and add gradual A/B weight manager to the console.
next_steps: Finalize rollback trigger thresholds with SRE (proposal: p99 latency > 2x baseline for 3 consecutive evaluation windows OR error rate delta > 0.5%).
Add automated canary teardown when semantic similarity score drops below 0.85 on shadowed responses.
Make fallback lattice visible in Console rollout UI and expose actionable telemetry (predicted headroom, compatibility score, cost delta).
Hardening: add admission control gating based on downstream dependent services' SLOs (e.g., Reranker, Retrieval).
Run canary on two customer tenants with opt-in to validate enterprise policy overrides.
acceptance_criteria: Compatibility-aware fallback selection: orchestrator selects fallback target with highest compatibility score given runtime constraints.
Preserves latency SLOs in 90th percentile of tested simulated outages in staging for all three capacity tiers.
Auto-rollback triggers on defined SLO regressions and semantic quality regressions observed via shadowing.
Expose fallback plan and runtime decisions in Console for any active rollout within 5s of decision.
End-to-end tests covering cross-region failover, intra-region degraded variant selection, and policy override paths added to CI.
review_feedback: PM (Lena Gomez): Please ensure enterprise customers can pin allowed fallback regions — solved via manifest policy toggle.
SRE (Omar Khan): Need explicit circuit-breaker backoff config — will add 3-tier exponential backoff and cooldown window.
Design (Ruth Park): Console visualization should surface predicted cost delta clearly; we should show 'estimated tokens saved' and 'expected latency impact'.
Security (Nina Rao): Confirm that shadowed traffic is scrubbed for PII before sending to experimental variants in other regions — added plan to enforce KMS-based masking.
